newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish March industrial production highest ever.
newsitem.headline: Swedish March industrial production highest ever.

text.p: The telecoms and automotive industry helped boost Sweden's March industrial production to its highest level ever, Statistics Sweden said on Tuesday.
March industrial production rose 2.6 percent from February and 9.3 percent from March last year, the agency said.
"The production level is thereby the highest recorded so far and is 0.2 percent higher than the previous record level in December 1996," the agency said.
Telecoms and automotive industry production surged by seven percent and six percent respectively, Statistics Sweden said.
